name: Home on the Range
summary: At Valormok in Azshara, Kurll needs Mosshoof Hides to repair his tent. He has been exposed to the weather since it was damaged in a skirmish with blood elves.

sections.title: A Roof Again
sections.body: Kurll's tent at Valormok was damaged in a skirmish with the blood elves. For three nights, he has been left without shelter from the elements. He needs Mosshoof Hides to mend it, but lack of sleep keeps him from hunting. Bring him five hides, and he can sleep beneath a cover again.

faq.answer: Kurll is at Valormok in Azshara, where his tent needs repair.

faq.q: Why does Kurll need Mosshoof Hides?
faq.answer: Kurll needs Mosshoof Hides to repair his tent, which was damaged in a skirmish with blood elves.

faq.q: How many hides does Kurll need?
faq.answer: Kurll asks you to bring him five Mosshoof Hides.
Kurll says the easiest mosshooves to hunt are west and south of Valormok. The hide of any mosshoof will do.

faq.q: How long has Kurll been without shelter?
faq.answer: Kurll says he has been at the mercy of the elements for three nights.

attribution: In-game quest text: Home on the Range
